# has lexical form

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasLexicalForm`](gmeow-hasLexicalForm.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasLexicalForm>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

The concrete form(s) of a lexical item. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single item may have many forms (written, spoken, reconstructed, etc.), and competing form claims from different standpoints coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
